## Document Version Control System

New document uploaded → Code generates SHA-256 version hash →
Saved to Google Drive with version suffix →
Version history logged to Sheets → Email notification sent.

**Setup:**
1. Set Google Drive folder for versioned documents
2. Set Google Sheets for version history log
3. Set Gmail credentials
4. POST { documentName, author, changeDescription } + binary to webhook
